resources.string: AI Agents that get things done
Please enable the following permissions for the app to work properly

This is the core permission for AI to control your device.
1. Go to Settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps 2. Find \"Octopus Mobile\" in the list 3. Turn on the switch 4. Confirm in the system dialog
Keeps the app running in the background to prevent it from being killed by the system.\n\nJust tap the card on the home screen to enable it. Android 13+ will ask for notification permission first.

Displays a floating panel showing AI execution status.
1. Go to Settings → Apps → Octopus Mobile 2. Find \"Display over other apps\" 3. Turn on the switch
Prevents the system from stopping the app in the background.\n\nTap the card on the home screen, then confirm \"Allow\" in the system dialog. (Some devices may require setting to \"Unrestricted\")

Allows the AI to read and write files on your device.

Android 11+: Go to Settings → enable "All files access"
Android 10 and below: Grant permission in the popup dialog
Tap protected dialogs, screenshot secure windows

By default the AI uses Android\'s accessibility API, which is enough for most apps. A few things it can\'t do:
• Tap permission/system dialogs (FLAG_SECURE) • Screenshot DRM-protected screens • Force-stop other apps, change system settings
For these, install Shizuku — a safe, open-source helper.

Setup steps:
1. Install Shizuku from Play Store or GitHub
2. Start it via wireless debugging (Android 11+) or PC ADB — once is enough
3. Come back here — Octopus Mobile picks it up automatically
